vote.summary: The recommendation cleanly separates the confused 'modes' into orthogonal policy axes plus opinionated presets, preserves existing Tickety terminology and architecture, adds a minimal policy/run/finding layer, sequences value before durable orchestration, and states concrete migration, security, failure, and rollback controls. It does not claim ServiceNow or provider-write parity and leaves unresolved unknowns explicitly out of scope. No material requirement or edge case in the current decision scope is left unaddressed.
requirements_covered: Correctly distinguish watchdog, on-demand, and analytical examples as different concerns
Back user-facing Operating Profiles with orthogonal policy axes and allow concurrent profiles
Keep APP_MODE, process role, standalone/provider placement independent of profiles
Manager Briefing: on-demand manager oversight with truthful freshness and read-only side effects
Agent Assist: per-ticket in-context help with bounded context and read-only side effects
Continuous Watch: periodic/event-driven oversight without overclaiming realtime, later action-gated
Human boundaries: approvals, reviewable drafts, no unauthorized external mutation
Composition and conflict resolution: deny wins, narrowest scope, least authority, dedupe, no competing writes
Reuse existing APIs, worker, APScheduler, eligibility checks, budgets, contracts, provenance, and retention
Introduce only minimal primitives: ProfileDefinition, ProfileBinding, ProfileRun, Finding, later ProposedAction
Define a measurable threshold for durable orchestration and defer platform work until needed
Migration preserves AUTO_* toggles and existing routes with verified equivalence and rollback
Security/failure controls: tenant isolation, RBAC, budgets, circuits, queues, webhook replay defense, kill switches
Delivery sequence validates read-only MVP before Continuous Watch, then guarded orchestration and actions
State assumptions and unknowns without claiming ServiceNow or provider parity
implementation_options: Flat mutually exclusive mode list (rejected: conflates trigger, persona, scope, authority)
Independent policy axes only (retained as internal model but not primary UX)
Full durable event orchestration now (deferred until measured requirements justify it)
Separate narrow watchdog service (rejected initially; reuse governed worker/policy infra)
Query-only on-demand intelligence (retained inside Manager Briefing and Agent Assist)
Named AI agents / general multi-agent framework (rejected as primary abstraction)
Policy axes + opinionated profiles + incremental executor (chosen)
details_checked: Freshness labeling, source_as_of/evaluated_at, and truthful degraded/partial states
Dedupe by tenant, binding, resource/version, finding type, policy version
Idempotency keys and avoidance of retrying non-idempotent provider writes
RBAC and tenant/binding isolation fail-closed boundaries
Signed webhook replay, out-of-order, signature/timestamp validation, quarantine ambiguity
APScheduler insufficiency criteria and minimal EventEnvelope normalization
AUTO_* toggle migration equivalence, opt-in, rollback, and dual-observe
Kill switches, budgets, concurrency limits, circuits, queues, load shedding, no ambient LLM loops
External/portal text untrusted and explicit authenticated eligibility requirement
No ServiceNow implementation, provider parity, unmeasured SLO, or autonomous irreversible action implied
Action gates: adapter capability, identity, RBAC, approval, idempotency, receipt, reversal limits
Continuous vs near-real-time terminology constrained to measured event paths
vote.proposed_artifact: Approved as-is: adopt the supplied canonical Tickety operating profiles recommendation v0 without revision.
